title: A kid, alone

greeting.text: The bell. Nobody there. Then a hand comes up over the edge of the counter, and a face after it.
Excuse me. Have you seen my mum and dad?

annoyed: Are you nearly finished looking at me?

notes.wrist: No card. The kid lays both hands flat on the counter, palms up, the way you'd show a teacher they were clean.
notes.reflection: The mirror in the corner. The kid sways on its feet. Watch the mirror. Watch the kid.
notes.shadow: Small sneakers. One lace undone. The floor around them is busy.

topics.ask: No, mate. I'm sorry. Come in out of the cold.
topics.note: The kid's breath doesn't fog. Neither does yours. You hadn't noticed that before.

topics.ask: Where did you last see them?
topics.answer: In the car. Dad said wait here. Then somebody said wait here again, from the trees, in Dad's voice. So I waited there instead.

topics.note: It says it the way you said it. The same small rise at the end.

topics.ask: What do your parents look like?
topics.answer: Like me. They're going to look just like me.

topics.ask: Who's that standing either side of you?

wren.arrive: Oh, look at it. Poor little thing.
wren.adviceLine: It only wants something warm and to be on its way. Look how hard it's trying, Sam. Give it what it wants.

after.serve: There. Wasn't that kind? You're so good with them.
after.turnAway: It'll find someone softer. They always do. ...Don't look at me like that.
after.break: You didn't have to make it show you. It was doing so well.

serve.text: Here. It's hot. There's a ranger station at the bottom of the hill.
Thank you. You're nice. They said you'd be nice.
It carries the cup out in both hands. It does not drink from it.

turnAway.text: It goes. At the glass it turns around and stands with its hands by its sides, looking in. It is still there the next time you look.

shelter.text: Come round the back. You can wait there until it's light.
Is that where you keep them?
Wren takes its hand before you can ask what it meant.

break.text: Oh. You get it. And you're doing so well, too.
It leaves the way it came. It does not open the door to do it.

report.serve: A family heading east say they picked up a child walking the centre line near Corrigan's Pass at about five this morning. The Tarrow roadblock reports their car has not come through. It has been four hours.
report.turnAway: Rangers want to stress that no child has been reported missing on the pass. If you see a child on the road, alone, do not stop the car.
report.shelter: Corrigan's Roadhouse did not answer the dawn call-in. A patrol will go up when the fog allows.
report.break: A child's jumper has been found on the centre line east of Corrigan's. It has no label, and no seams.
report.missed: Several drivers report a child standing at the glass of Corrigan's Roadhouse at first light, waiting to be let in.
